text:
Gavin McKenna, the first overall pick in June, has six goals and 13 points in 20 games as an 18-year-old, seven of them on the power play. Our win probability has his goals adding more wins than most veterans'. That's a strong start by any measure.

It's also been a hard one, which is normal and loud in Toronto. The Leafs have 40% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, nearly eight points worse than without him, and The Hockey News called his last weekend "growing pains." His minutes (14 a night, up to 15 since Kirill Marchenko went down) have been a talking point for critics of the coaching staff.

History is on his side. Of 38 forwards picked in the top three since 2005 with four or more seasons, all 38 reached 200 games. His shooting (16.7%) will cool. His role should grow. Our range: 38 to 64 points.
